description:
Define how downloaded desktop apps discover each other and coexist with a locally running swarm.

This should specify:
- default precedence when a downloaded app and a local-swarm instance of the same scenario both exist
- resolution semantics for inter-scenario calls that use the standard discovery package
- how bundled apps expose Vrooli-compatible discovery behavior
- the cross-platform contract expected for macOS, Windows, and Linux
- the future seam for explicit override/configuration without blocking the default behavior now
- the regression cases required to prove downloaded-app plus downloaded-app and downloaded-app plus local-swarm topologies work correctly

Working assumption from planning: downloaded desktop apps should win over same-scenario local swarm instances by default.

Goal: Vrooli desktop apps behave like one coherent ecosystem instead of isolated bundles.
name: desktop-runtime-discovery-precedence-contract
title: Define The Desktop Runtime Discovery And Precedence Contract
